info.title: BDSPro REST API
info.description: HTTP API. Optional OAuth2/OpenID Connect and phone endpoints are enabled by validated provider configuration.

get.summary: Current account with person profile, security flags and preferences
List active organizations with current account's role and capabilities
List active members of organization (owner only)

404.description: Not an active owner or organization absent

get.summary: Get organization and current account membership and capabilities

404.description: Organization absent or account not an active member

post.summary: Verify signup OTP and create account
Verify login OTP and issue tokens
Request password reset for verified email
Set password and revoke refresh sessions

get.summary: List active refresh sessions for current account

200.description: Active sessions without refresh token secrets

post.summary: Revoke all refresh sessions including current one

204.description: All refresh sessions revoked; access tokens expire normally

get.summary: List organization teams visible to an active member
List active team members with bounded pagination

post.summary: Add existing organization member to team (owner only)
Issue a durable invitation to a verified organization member
Accept a single-use team invitation with verified email

get.summary: Start OAuth2 / OpenID Connect OAuth sign-in

post.summary: Start OAuth2 / OpenID Connect account linking
Reauthenticate with a linked OAuth2/OIDC identity to start phone binding

get.description: Returns at most 50 newest successful login events for the verified caller. Contains IP addresses and user agents; clients must protect this security data.

get.summary: Review authorization request without issuing a code
get.description: Requires an existing BDSPro access JWT; the caller must obtain explicit user consent before POST.

schema.description: UUID of a registered public OAuth client
Caller-generated anti-CSRF state of at least 16 URL-safe characters

200.description: Client details and current consent_version; GET never grants consent

post.summary: Approve or deny OAuth2 Authorization Code grant
post.description: Uses a BDSPro access JWT and explicit approve=true. Only a registered exact-match redirect may receive an authorization code.

client_id.description: UUID of a registered public OAuth client

state.description: Caller-generated anti-CSRF state of at least 16 URL-safe characters

consent_version.description: Required when approve=true; must echo the version from GET /oauth/authorize

302.description: Redirect to registered client with code+state or access_denied

post.summary: Exchange authorization code or rotate refresh token
post.description: Public clients; Authorization Code with PKCE S256 and refresh_token grants only. Returns opaque scoped tokens. Password grant is not supported.

200.description: Opaque access and rotated refresh tokens

post.summary: Revoke OAuth2 access token or refresh-token family
post.description: RFC7009-style idempotent revocation for a public client.

get.summary: Read account identity with a scoped OAuth2 token
get.description: Requires an opaque access token with profile:read; returns subject only, not email or email_verified. Application JWTs are rejected.

200.description: Authenticated subject only; contact details are not released

get.summary: List active third-party client authorizations for current account
get.description: Account-scoped active consent grants; remain listed after access token expiry until account revokes consent.

delete.summary: Revoke current account authorization for an OAuth client
delete.description: Advance persistent consent version and revoke this account's codes and tokens; does not delete the client application.

post.summary: Register a public PKCE OAuth2 client

redirect_uri.description: HTTPS redirect or HTTP loopback URI

201.description: Registered client UUID and exact redirect URI

TeamInviteIssuedResponse.description: Raw invitation tokens are never returned by the API.

OAuth2LinkRequest.description: Exactly one fresh proof: current password or a phone login OTP for the phone already bound to the account.
